description: Reads a Teradata EXPLAIN result the agent ran this turn and draws it as a graph of steps — operation, inputs, join method, data movement, row estimates and their confidence — with the findings a plan reader looks for first: product joins, estimates made without statistics, redistribution and duplication, full scans.

tool_definition.name: TDA_ExplainPlan
tool_definition.description: Reads the result of an EXPLAIN that ran THIS turn (statement number; the latest EXPLAIN by default) and returns the plan as steps with findings (product joins, estimates without statistics, data movement, full scans); the user sees it drawn as a graph. Run `EXPLAIN <the SELECT>` with your SQL tool first — this tool does not run SQL. Teradata plans only.

statement.description: Statement number of the EXPLAIN this turn. Omit for the latest EXPLAIN.
